ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure. After ignoring the curved arrows, the static connectivity is: on the left there is an independent Bu fragment and it bears a negative charge; in the main skeleton, the adjacent carbon bears H, R2, and R3, and is connected to the imine carbon on the right; this imine carbon is also connected to R1 and is double-bonded to N; this imine nitrogen is further connected to a negatively charged N, which is connected to a Ts group. Reasoning: According to the specified method, represent R1, R2, and R3 with the wildcard *; write the central imine carbon as connected to the R1 wildcard and C(*)*, and double-bonded to N\[N-]Ts; expand Ts as p-toluenesulfonyl S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1; write the independent Bu anion on the left as CCC[C-], separated from the main fragment with a dot. Therefore the SMILES obtained is: */C(=N\[N-]S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1)C(*)*.CCC[C-].

method.method_draft: First visually transcribe only the static connectivity in the drawing, discarding the electron-flow arrows. Convert the substrate skeleton into a SMILES fragment with a central imine carbon attached to wildcard R1 and to `C(*)*` for the adjacent carbon bearing R2/R3 and implicit H, and double-bonded to `N\[N-]Ts`. Expand `Ts` to the p-toluenesulfonyl SMILES and append the separate butyl anion fragment after a dot. This yields `*/C(=N\[N-]S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1)C(*)*.CCC[C-]`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，忽略弯箭头后，静态连接关系为：左侧有一个独立的 Bu 片段且带负电；主骨架中，相邻碳带有 H、R2、R3，并连接到右侧的亚胺碳；该亚胺碳还连接 R1，并与 N 成双键；该亚胺氮再连接到带负电的 N，后者连接 Ts 基团。推理：按指定方法，将 R1、R2、R3 用通配符 * 表示；中心亚胺碳写作连接 R1 通配符和 C(*)*，并双键连接到 N\[N-]Ts；Ts 展开为 p-甲苯磺酰基 S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1；左侧独立 Bu 阴离子写为 CCC[C-]，用点号与主片段分开。因此得到 SMILES：*/C(=N\[N-]S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1)C(*)*.CCC[C-]。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct visual-to-SMILES transcription is the natural single route for this image-grounded identification task; it relies on reading the drawn connectivity rather than deriving the structure from a reaction mechanism.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a hydrazone/anionic tosylhydrazone transition-state drawing while ignoring all curved arrows: a central carbon is bonded to R1, to a neighboring carbon bearing H/R2/R3, and double-bonded to N; that N is single-bonded to a negatively charged N attached to Ts. A separate Bu anion is also shown near the abstracted H.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to know that the requested output is the SMILES expression for the depicted transition-state structure and that curved arrows must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: replace generic R groups by wildcard atoms `*`; encode the tosyl group `Ts` as `S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C)cc1`; encode the negatively charged nitrogen as `[N-]`; encode the butyl carbanion as `CCC[C-]`; separate disconnected species with `.`; preserve the depicted C=N stereochemistry with `/` and `\` bond markers.
